payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the training sets of ELMo models, indicating that the original model was trained on a one billion word corpus, while later models for many languages were trained on significantly smaller datasets, such as 20 million words.

claims.text: The original ELMo model was trained on a one billion word corpus.
Later ELMo models for many languages were trained on datasets as small as 20 million words.
The Latvian ELMo model was trained on a corpus of about 280 million tokens, which is larger than the 20 million words used in the ELMoForManyLangs project.
